appointment_series_rule.name: appointment_series_rule
appointment_series_rule.value:
("appointment_series"."frequency" = 'weekly' and "appointment_series"."interval_weeks" between 1 and 4 and "appointment_series"."monthly_mode" is null)
       or ("appointment_series"."frequency" = 'monthly' and "appointment_series"."interval_weeks" is null and "appointment_series"."monthly_mode" is not null)
